intent: Give Esteban Moreno Media a stable NFC-card destination with immediate contact, Maps, review and portfolio actions.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The physical NFC card needs a small backup destination rather than the full-site navigation.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: No añadir una cinta de contacto si el contacto ya está a un toque — ESTEBAN
visual_evidence.comparison: Phone and desktop rendering of the dedicated card route.

references.borrow: Actions stay visible, compact and comfortable.
references.avoid: A floating contact dock or a competing second primary action.

brief.visitor: A person who scans the physical NFC contact card.
brief.promise: Reach Esteban, find the Google profile, leave a review, or see his work in one tap.
brief.friction: A generic link page makes the recipient search for the right action and can expose private location details.

kpi.outcome: contact intent from an NFC scan
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: no card route or prior scan event exists; read the first comparable production event export after release.
kpi.evidence: No card route exists before this change.
kpi.decision_rule: retain if the card is usable and actions are measurable

concept.idea: A small editorial contact card, not a link farm.
concept.brand_reason: Warm paper, ink and terracotta retain Esteban's identity while keeping decisions calm.
concept.interaction: Normal links and a downloadable vCard.
concept.visible_response: Four primary actions and compact secondary links are present in first HTML.
concept.direct_path: WhatsApp, call, Google Maps, review instructions, portfolio.
concept.alternatives: Do not use a third-party link host, public address, rating claim or motion-dependent content.

story.opening: Who Esteban is and what he does.
story.action: Choose a contact or Google action.
story.consequence: The selected app or page opens.
story.next_step: Start a project or leave a Google review.

references.borrow: Esteban's existing warm editorial colors and contact language.
references.avoid: Home hero treatment, a floating contact dock, or generic card stacks.

components.reuse: Canonical site contact data, metadata helper and analytics component.
components.local_reason: NFC destination needs a chrome-free brand-specific layout.

verification.motion: No motion required; reduced motion is identical.
verification.accessibility_performance: Visible focus, semantic links and no horizontal overflow.
verification.raw_html: Contact data, Maps link, review help and vCard route exist in served HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: WhatsApp link resolves to the canonical phone number.

learning.baseline_source: UNKNOWN: no prior /card route exists; collect the first comparable production event export after release
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: no route existed before this build
learning.hypothesis: Putting the exact actions on one short phone screen removes the friction after an NFC scan.
learning.decision_rule: retain when production read is usable and action clicks are captured
learning.registration_condition: verify the production analytics event after release
